name: Midtown Manhattan
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Midtown Manhattan, NY
blurb: The Hudson River Park piers between 44th and 56th Streets, where most of Manhattan’s boathouses and outfitters are based. Busy with ferries, and the current runs hard on a big tide.

tide.label: NOAA 8530645 Weehawken
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8530645 at Weehawken, a mile across the river.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.

current.label: NOAA NYH1928_12 Pier 92
current.note: Current from NOAA station NYH1928_12 (Hudson River, Pier 92), a third of a mile from the piers, at the 6 ft bin nearest the surface.
